subject: facet_grid margin option -- can I have it only do horizontal?

messages.author: 91843c5602a10b9b
messages.subject: facet_grid margin option -- can I have it only do horizontal?
parts:
Hi,

Regarding facet_grid margin option, it is binary. Is there any way to
have it only do the horizontal and not vertical margins?

Thank you,

Xu

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: facet_grid margin option -- can I have it only do horizontal?
parts:
Yes, just supply the variables you want to margin over. (This is a
bit buggy at the moment, but will be fixed in the next version)

Hadley
